append.text: **Ps 135 (27×) *quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia ejus* → *porque é para sempre a sua misericórdia*** — D23 applied: Ps 117's refrain word for word, one slot in 27 verses; *porque a sua misericórdia é eterna* (MS1932) the option. No reader objected.

**Ps 135:15 *excússit Pharaónem, et virtútem ejus* → *e o seu poder*** (v2): draft 1 took D43's plural *as suas forças* (heard as the army by the blind reader); the Latinist (minor) refused the change of number; the row's singular taken, not his *a sua força* (fortitúdo's). *o seu exército* (MS1932, DRB) the option.
**Ps 135:10, 135:17 *Qui percússit* → *feriu*** (the Egyptians, the kings); the ambiguity reader heard 'struck down'.
**Ps 135:5 *Qui fecit cælos in intelléctu* → *fez os céus com entendimento*** — the row, not *sabedoria* (sapiéntia's, 103:24; MS1932, CNBB); heard as 'with wisdom'.

**Ps 135:23 *in humilitáte nostra* → *na nossa humilhação*** (CNBB Bible the same word); the v2 Latinist gate asked *abatimento* (minor: an agent implied) — held on the row, *abatimento* the option. Reads in the Vespers antiphon *Dai graças ao Senhor, pois na nossa humilhação se lembrou de nós*.
**Ps 135:24 *Et redémit nos* → *E nos resgatou*** (proclisis after *E*, as 105:10).

**Ps 135:11, 135:14 *edúxit Israël de médio eórum / per médium ejus* → *fez sair … do meio deles / pelo meio dele*** — one verb twice as the Latin, though the Greek varies (ἐξαγαγόντι / διαγαγόντι); *fez passar* is kept for *tradúxit* (135:16).

**Ps 135:23 *Quia … * quóniam* → *Pois … * porque*** — a second use: where *quia* opens a verse whose refrain says *quóniam → porque*, *pois* keeps the Latin's two words apart (the stylist heard *Porque … porque* as a stutter, his worst line).

**Ps 135:12 *brácchio excélso* → *braço levantado*** — a local departure: said of an arm, the concrete image (rule 5); the stylist asked it and the ambiguity reader did not know *excelso*; MS1932 *levantado*. The v2 Latinist gate asked *excelso* back (minor) — held, *excelso* the option. The row stands for excélsus said of God.
**Ps 135:25 *Qui dat escam omni carni* → *dá alimento a toda a carne*** — God giving food is *alimento* (103:21, 103:27); *comida* where men eat or crave (68:22, 77:18, 77:30, 106:18).

**Ps 135:8–9 *in potestátem diéi / noctis* (εἰς ἐξουσίαν) → *para o domínio do dia / da noite*** — the row held at its named test; the blind reader heard 'to rule the day'. *para governar* (CNBB) and the stylist's *domínio sobre* are options.

**Ps 135:15 *excússit Pharaónem … in Mari Rubro* (ἐκτινάξαντι) → *sacudiu Faraó*** — the same Greek verb; L&S 'shake off, throw off … in mare'. The ambiguity reader found the image unclear; *precipitou* (MS1932) the option.

terms: | Qui … (litany of relatives after *Confitémini*) | *Àquele que …* (*Àquele que faz grandes maravilhas, só ele*) | open | Ps 135:4–25 (10×). The stylist (v1): written *Aquele que* leaves a subject with no verb, while the ear hears the lines going on from *Dai graças ao Senhor* — the Greek's datives (τῷ ποιοῦντι). The crasis makes each line the object of the thanks; the v2 Latinist approved it. *Aquele que* (113:8, not after an imperative) stays there. |

| tradúcere | fazer passar (*Àquele que fez passar o seu povo pelo deserto*) | open | Ps 135:16; the *trans-* of leading across; kept apart from *edúcere → fazer sair* and *perdúcere → conduzir* (77:13, 77:52). *conduziu* (MS1932, DRB) option. |

| divídere … in divisiónes | partir … em partes (*partiu o Mar Vermelho em partes*) | open | Ps 135:13; the Latin's figura etymologica (καταδιελόντι … εἰς διαιρέσεις) kept in two plain words; *dividiu … em divisões* and *dividiu … em partes* (DRB) options; *em duas partes* (MS1932, CNBB) adds the Hebrew's number. |
| luminária | luminares (*os grandes luminares*) | open | Ps 135:7; MS1932, the Liturgia das Horas and the CNBB Bible all have it; unknown to the ambiguity reader; *luzeiros* option. |

| Ps 135 names | Seon, amorreus (lower case), Og, Basã, Faraó (no article), Mar Vermelho, Egito, Israel | open | Ps 135:15, 19–20. *Basã* as 67:23; *Seon*, *Og*, *amorreus* as MS1932 and the CNBB Bible and Liturgia das Horas (fetched, `ps135/circulation.md`). The kings take *a* as objects of *matou* across the refrain (*A Seon … E a Og*, MS1932 and the LH). **Ps 134:11 has the same names and should match.** Unknown to the ambiguity reader — expected. |

Brazil prays *Porque eterno é seu amor* (CNBB LH, Hebrew *ḥesed*) — not taken. |
